Cyber Threat Protection Resource Get Malicious Urls
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cyberThreatProtection/maliciousUrls

Retrieves the malicious URLs added to the denylist in the Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) policy

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
maliciousUrls
string[]
REQUIRED

List of malicious URLs that are blocked by the ATP policy
